title: Directed proper-refinement comparison intertwines ambient projection maps
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; their structure maps need not be separated [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On small pro-etale sites choose either $\mathcal D_T=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ at a fixed level, or $\mathcal D_T=D(\mathscr S_T)$, where $\mathscr S_T$ is the category of sheaves of $A_n$-modules $M_n$ with semilinear quotient transitions $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_{n+1}\to A_n}M_n$ and componentwise transition-compatible morphisms. Use the ordinary unbounded, simultaneous ringed-diagram-site operations [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $P_u=Lu^*$, $S_u=Ru_*$, $J_a=a_!$, and use the canonical conjugate compositors $d:P_uP_v\cong P_{vu}$, $c:S_vS_u\cong S_{vu}$, $e:J_bJ_a\cong J_{ba}$ and normalized proper/open mate $\Gamma_Q$ of [lem-sf-ambient-proper-open-pasting]. All equations include these compositors and the tensor associators. In the system case they are equations before evaluation or total limit, with every quotient transition retained.
Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, let $c_a=(j_a:X\hookrightarrow W_a,p_a:W_a\to Y)$ for $a=1,2$ be compactifications, and let $u:W_1\to W_2$ be proper with $uj_1=j_2$, $p_2u=p_1$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Set $F_a=S_{p_a}J_{j_a}$ and
$$C_u=c_{p_2,u}J_{j_1}\circ S_{p_2}\Gamma_{(j_1,j_2,1_X,u)}:F_2\longrightarrow F_1.$$
For $K\in\mathcal D_X$, $L\in\mathcal D_Y$ arbitrary, define $\operatorname{PF}^{c_a}_{K,L}=S_{p_a}(\delta_{j_a})\pi_{p_a;J_{j_a}K,L}$ using the counit-defined $\pi$ and normalized open tensor $\delta$ [def-exchange-projection, lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], with $P_{j_a}P_{p_a}\cong P_f$. Then
$$C_u(K\otimes P_fL)\operatorname{PF}^{c_2}_{K,L}=\operatorname{PF}^{c_1}_{K,L}(C_uK\otimes1_L).$$
This is a jointly natural equality in the displayed direction for the specified refinement map, for every unbounded input in both coefficient settings. It requires no inverse of $C_u$, Tor amplitude, constructibility or normalized-system hypothesis.

proof.text: Expand the finite and simultaneous-system comparison and projection words using [def-sf-refinement-projection-words]. The local inner equation is [lem-sf-refinement-projection-local-tensor]. The outer proper compositor equation is [lem-sf-refinement-projection-proper-composition]. First-variable naturality of the proper projection moves gamma past the outer projection. Functoriality combines R(delta) with R(gamma); apply the local equation, naturality of comp, and the outer composition equation. Tensor functoriality combines the two comparison factors into exactly C_u(K). These are the proved projectionPasting equations in the factor-interface module. The system argument takes place in the actual simultaneous category, before evaluation.
